## Problem and resulting change

Refs #

## Scope and dependencies

Link the owning issue and relevant contracts/decisions. Identify any
cross-repository prerequisites and explicitly state source versus installation
or physical scope.

## Validation

Record commands/results, actual specification inventory, and any unavailable
evidence. Do not equate CI with client or physical acceptance.

## Fixed comparison and reviews

Record base SHA, head SHA, merge-base, diff command and clean worktree.
Record independent Standards and Specification reviews and finding dispositions.
For UI changes, record approval of the current candidate.

## Delivery

Verify all configured current-head PR jobs, guarded merge and merged-revision
main CI before issue closure.
